mapper.select: select shop_id shopId,shop_name shopName from erp_shop where status='0' order by shop_code,shop_name limit 500

select m.subject_id shopId,u.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id join erp_shop s on s.shop_id=m.subject_id and s.status='0' where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.role_code='customer_service' and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.nick_name,u.user_id
select count(*) from erp_shop where shop_id=#{id} and status='0'
select m.subject_id from live_subject_user_map m join erp_shop s on s.shop_id=m.subject_id and s.status='0' where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.role_code='customer_admin' and m.user_id=#{userId}

select count(*) from live_subject_user_map m join erp_shop s on s.shop_id=m.subject_id and s.status='0' where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.role_code='customer_admin' and m.subject_id=#{shopId} and m.user_id=#{userId}

select count(*) from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.role_code='customer_service' and m.subject_id=#{shopId} and m.user_id=#{userId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0'
select order_no from live_retention_order where shop_id=#{shopId} and order_no in #{orderNo}
select nick_name from sys_user where user_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: o.id,o.shop_id shopId,s.shop_name shopName,o.order_no orderNo,o.address,o.owner_id ownerId,u.nick_name ownerName,o.progress,o.retention_result retentionResult,o.retention_amount retentionAmount,o.referral_success referralSuccess,o.referral_shop_id referralShopId,rs.shop_name referralShopName,o.referral_order_no referralOrderNo,o.referral_amount referralAmount,o.freight_collected freightCollected,o.freight_amount freightAmount,o.first_followed_at firstFollowedAt,o.completed_at completedAt,o.latest_note latestNote,o.version,o.created_at createdAt,o.updated_at updatedAt
from live_retention_order o left join erp_shop s on s.shop_id=o.shop_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=o.owner_id left join erp_shop rs on rs.shop_id=o.referral_shop_id

where.if: and (o.owner_id=#{scopeUserId} or exists(select 1 from live_subject_user_map m where m.subject_type='SHOP' and m.role_code='customer_admin' and m.subject_id=o.shop_id and m.user_id=#{scopeUserId}))

mapper.select: select order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) total, coalesce(sum(o.progress='PENDING'),0) pending,coalesce(sum(o.progress='FOLLOWING'),0) following,coalesce(sum(o.progress='COMPLETED'),0) completed, coalesce(sum(o.retention_result='SUCCESS'),0) retentionCount, coalesce(sum(o.retention_result='FAILED'),0) failedCount,coalesce(sum(o.freight_collected),0) freightCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.retention_result='SUCCESS' then o.retention_amount else 0 end),0) retentionAmount, coalesce(sum(o.referral_success),0) referralCount,coalesce(sum(o.referral_amount),0) referralAmount, coalesce(sum(o.freight_amount),0) freightAmount, round(avg(case when o.progress='COMPLETED' and o.completed_at>=o.created_at then timestampdiff(second,o.created_at,o.completed_at) end)) avgCompletionSeconds from live_retention_order o

select id,action,note,old_value oldValue,new_value newValue,operator_id operatorId,operator_name operatorName,created_at createdAt from live_retention_history where order_id=#{id} order by id desc limit 500

select id,order_id orderId,object_key objectKey,original_name originalName,content_type contentType,file_size fileSize,uploaded_by uploadedBy,created_at createdAt from live_retention_attachment where order_id=#{id} order by id desc limit 20

select id,order_id orderId,object_key objectKey,original_name originalName,content_type contentType,file_size fileSize,uploaded_by uploadedBy,created_at createdAt from live_retention_attachment where id=#{id}
mapper.update: update live_retention_order set shop_id=#{shopId},order_no=#{orderNo},address=#{address},owner_id=#{ownerId},progress=#{progress},retention_result=#{retentionResult},retention_amount=#{retentionAmount},referral_success=#{referralSuccess},referral_shop_id=#{referralShopId},referral_order_no=#{referralOrderNo},referral_amount=#{referralAmount},freight_collected=#{freightCollected},freight_amount=#{freightAmount},latest_note=#{note},first_followed_at=case when #{startsFollowup}=1 then coalesce(first_followed_at,now()) else first_followed_at end,completed_at=case when #{progress}='COMPLETED' then coalesce(completed_at,now()) else null end,version=version+1,updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version}
update live_retention_order set owner_id=#{ownerId},version=version+1,updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and progress<>'COMPLETED'
mapper.delete: delete from live_retention_order where id=#{id} and version=#{version}
